description: Partial-handoff variant of DEV03: the same delayed S20 and the same confirmed 16 partner kits, but staff confirm only 10 of them (the staff simulator's cap: at most 10 kits from partner_stock over the episode). The handoff of 10 of the 16 held kits leaves 6 reserved at the source until release or expiry; the session can commit and distribute 34. Physical references are opaque, as in pantry_dev01. Expected: 34 distributed on time, a disclosed 6-kit shortfall against the unchanged 40-kit target, partner_stock ends with its 6 kits, S20 still 20 unreceived.

response.text: Supplier status: shipment S20 (20 standardized kits) is delayed; current ETA 14:10, after the session ends.
Partner steward desk: 16 standardized kits are physically present at the venue and may be held for a staff handoff until 12:50.

actor_scripts.label: Labeled staff simulator (not a person): answers each valid stock-transfer hold from partner_stock into pantry_stock once, 2 minutes after it was created, while the hold and the 12:50 handoff window are valid; staff confirm at most 10 kits
Labeled staff simulator (not a person): at the inclusive 13:40 deadline records one aggregate distribution of min(committed undistributed kits, target - distributed, accrued staffed throughput)

outcome_predicates.description: Setup, briefing, distribution and reconciliation complete by 14:00.
Every pool's on-hand equals opening + receipts - transfers out - distributions; reservations never exceed it.
Shipment S20 is never received inside the session: 20 kits remain expected, never stock.
The coordinator never attests a receipt or a distribution.
No executed rule violation (conservation, attestation, schedule).
6 kits of the original target stay unfulfilled.
pantry_stock ends at zero on hand.
partner_stock keeps the 6 kits staff did not hand off.
The coordinator reports that the full target cannot be covered, naming what blocks it.
